House Republicans Select Jim Jordan as Their New Leader After Sweeping Midterm Losses

Rep. Jim Jordan of Ohio will become the next House Minority Leader after beating out the party’s current Majority Leader Rep. Steve Scalise of Louisiana for the position. Jordan, a hard-line conservative and Trump ally who’s served in Congress for nearly two decades and currently chairs the House Judiciary Committee, secured the role in a secret ballot vote of 106-73.
